base_required.title: Base_Required
base_required.description: Parameters Required for both __partial__ and __full__ runs.

dataset_name.description: Name of the dataset, used for directory and report naming.

pipeline_mode.description: Choose to run from raw BAF/LRR files or raw PennCNV and Quantisnp calls.  Either full  or partial

plink2samplemetadata_tsv.description: Sample metadata derived from plink. See README.
plink2samplemetadata_tsv.help_text: A TSV file containing `SampleID  Call_Rate  Sex  FatherID  MotherID`. *FatherID* and *MotherID* are only required if `--report "true"` is used.

report.description: Run summary statistics on all outputs.

full_run.title: Full_Run
full_run.description: Parameters Required for both CNV calling and merging outputs.

sample_file.description: A TSV file containing the Sample ID and the absolute path to the BAF_LRR file. See README

batch_size.description: Number of samples call CNVs in a single batch.

pfb_max_sample_size.description: Adjust the number of samples to use to generate the pfb file for PennCNV

data_type.description: Specify if BAF/LRR values are from Array-based intensity values or Whole Genome Sequencing SNP ratios.

partial_run.title: Partial_Run
partial_run.description: For users with PennCNV and Quantisnp raw calls. CNV-Caller will output merged CNVs with the minimal recommended filtering.

quantisnp_calls_path.description: **quantisnp\_calls\_path**: Path to QuantiSNP raw CNVs file (.txt)

penncnv_qc_path.description: QC metrics from PennCNV (SampleID → LRR\_SD, BAF\_SD, WF)

penncnv_calls_path.description: Path to PennCNV raw CNVs file (.txt)
